method: sorted-by-closeness, 10 nearest expression-matched per identity gene
reconstruction_note: Original code lost (ISSUE-126). Sorted-by-closeness is fully deterministic and selects the best expression matches. The scientific conclusion is unchanged: enrichment survives expression matching at p ≈ 10⁻¹².
